name: Floe
author: E. T. Carter
description: Pack ice seen straight down: pale moonlit plates drift and reseat themselves over channels of black water, while the leads between them breathe open and closed and pulse with faint bioluminescent light, brightest at mid-channel.

params.label: Plate size
params.effect: Average floe diameter in CSS pixels; small plates make broken brash ice, large plates a few continental slabs.

params.label: Drift speed
params.effect: Rate of the plates' wander — how quickly the water leads breathe open and closed.

params.label: Lead glow
params.effect: Intensity of the bioluminescent light in the water channels, from black inert leads to vividly glowing seams.
